findings.problem: has_role uses archetype strings agitator/general/ruler where current has_role expects a specific database role; native IDs are character_role_*.
findings.evidence: Actual frozen commander-assignment AST yields zero assigned commanders for an existing same-country Tatanka carrying character_role_general. In-memory parameter-only native-ID control assigns one. GAME executable 00_victoria_ep2_scripted_effects.txt:25 uses has_role=character_role_general. Raw general only occurs in commander_orders/orders.md. add_character_role explicitly supports either archetype or database role; has_role_of_type is the separate archetype predicate.
findings.repair: Use source-backed has_role_of_type=general/agitator/ruler or explicit character_role_* consistently. Recheck fallback general and global existing/exile/void cases; do not duplicate templates.

findings.problem: First exodus reads global_var:nesnd_hus_registration_exodus_epoch in the same boolean limit as has_global_variable, without a branch guard.
findings.evidence: Actual frozen full helper with valid native registration/epoch and pending, but no previous exodus global receipt, raises unguarded_RHS in the reused strict non-short-circuit AST evaluator. No 70/30 positive pass claimed.
findings.repair: Branch on receipt existence before comparing the numeric epoch; missing receipt must enter first-run movement. Keep each source-pop random_list lottery and immediate no-destination terminal.

findings.problem: No-HUS refuge branch references c:HUS in the same limit as exists=c:HUS.
findings.evidence: Actual frozen nesnd_restoration_refugees with a live pending NAH source and no HUS object raises unguarded scope c:HUS before the intended terminal_no_destination branch. Live-HUS control moves 40% once and clears pending.
findings.repair: Use a true exists branch before entering HUS scope, then alive/populated-state checks. Missing HUS must produce result3 without population movement or pending.

findings.problem: Khanate goal validity/on_enforced checks type and pair but not the stored dispatched DP identity or a transaction epoch.
findings.evidence: Actual frozen humiliation on_enforced with USA's stored actual-dispatched DP, but callback different-same-pair DP of the same type, accepts the callback, sets USA outcome2 and grants NKH first victory reward. Native DP and participants are explicit fixture facts; no war outcome is simulated.
findings.repair: Bind both sides/goal callback to the original country objects, current transaction epoch and exact stored DP, and require the matching dispatched/current case before writing outcome/reward. Preserve separate USA/HUS transactions. Restoration settlement already has an additional stored-play check; do not falsely classify both routes as identical.

findings.problem: Preview relies on earlier set/save effects to initialize capacity variables and temporary country/state scopes.
findings.evidence: Actual frozen nesnd_khanate_army on four populated NKH states, army_size0, preview with writes/saves skipped, reaches nesnd_a2_barrack_capacity while.limit and reads missing var:nesnd_a2_capacity_total. No engine UI result claimed.
findings.repair: Close all construction/army preview reads with explicit has_variable/exists branches; use safe defined values for zero-default counters. Keep actual mutation in hidden execution and native/cost previews separate. Audit the whole helper closure, not this first field alone.

findings.problem: Dynasty spawn windows use date as a country trigger.
findings.evidence: Current generated trigger registry contains game_date, not date; current executable bulgaria_events.txt:162/174/186 uses game_date. Tiger identifies four unknown date fields. History date syntax is a different context.
findings.repair: Use verified game_date conditions while preserving approved character windows, global seen/dead receipts and no resurrection.

findings.problem: War dispatch treats alliance and defensive_pact treaty-article IDs as diplomatic-action pact types.
findings.evidence: Current GAME defines those IDs only in common/treaty_articles, not common/diplomatic_actions; no aliases were located. has/remove_diplomatic_pact expects diplomatic-action type. Tiger emits four missing-item diagnoses. Actual native italian_unification.txt:680-718 filters exact binds pair and alliance/defensive_pact articles then withdraws the matching treaty.
findings.repair: Use the current native pair-scoped treaty route and preserve unrelated third-country relations. Do not globally remove alliances or invent a remove-article effect. Follow the actual native withdraw source and decide mixed-article treaty implications explicitly.
